stumbles.quote: The List Scout page now runs the folded model. Its classifier answers are identical, and fitting takes 1.2 s instead of 3.6 s.
stumbles.why: "List Scout page" is an unexplained name. The text doesn't say what is being fit, or why a classifier appears in an embedding-storage result.

stumbles.quote: The search indexes on the site are still 768-dimensional.
stumbles.why: This could contradict "live index" and "The List Scout page now runs the folded model", since the reader can't tell which indexes are meant. It also leaves the headline "Yes" unclear: the finding is tested but not deployed.

point: Folding Ettin-17m's output matrix to 256 dimensions leaves float search unchanged, and 3- or 4-bit codes on those 256 dimensions beat the current 2-bit, 768-dimension index at fewer bytes. At the same 2-bit width, 256 dimensions do worse.
